chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said:

Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was asked about the most common cause for entry into Paradise, and he replied: God-consciousness and good character. [And he was asked about the most common cause for entry into the Fire, and he replied: The two hollows: the stomach and the private part.]

key_terms.الأَجْوَفَانِ: The two hollows (referring to stomach and private part)

ai.seo_question: What are the main reasons for entering Paradise and Hell according to the Prophet Muhammad (S)?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) highlights the Prophet’s emphasis on *taqwa* and moral excellence as the dual keys to Paradise, while pinpointing the overindulgence of the stomach and the private parts as the primary gates to Hell. This narration underscores the Shia understanding of the body-soul connection, where physical moderation directly influences spiritual purity and ultimate salvation. It serves as a practical guide for believers to cultivate self-discipline in both dietary habits and sexual conduct to maintain spiritual health.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) said, “God’s Prophet (S) was asked what were the main reasons for entry into Paradise. He (a.s.) replied, “Fearing God and having a good temper.” He (a.s.) was asked what were the main reasons for entry into the Fire. He (a.s.) replied, “Stomach and sex.”
